limitations: The current LiteratureAtom schema is oriented toward conventional primary-study populations/exposures/outcomes; AI/ML model experiments were mapped conservatively into those fields only for quantitative result atoms.

Figure 7 provides plotted rather than tabulated scaling losses, so no approximate plot-readout values were encoded as quantitative atoms; the figure-level comparison was retained as a qualitative result.
No explicit funding or conflict-of-interest statement was located in the primary PDF; absence was not converted into an atom.
Brain-science claims were encoded as author conclusions/hypotheses rather than direct empirical neuroscience results.
No calculated-from-source or extractor-inference atoms were created; appraisal judgments are excluded from the atom set.
